rome-central-italy-abruzzo-gran-sasso-we.slogan: A 318 km loop out of Abruzzo Gran Sasso Weekend
rome-central-italy-abruzzo-gran-sasso-we.story: Scenery first, traffic last, with checkpoints that make sense on a bike. Out of Palombara Sabina and back again: 318 km, roughly 5 h 47 in the saddle. On the way it passes Ronciglione, Marina di Cerveteri, Torvaianica and Selcetta. The climb of the day is near Lariano. Long stretches are under trees.
